verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents high-resolution scans stored in the cloud, plus AI summaries and automatic labels/categorization. That implies text is extracted from scanned mail and gives some organization. However, no evidence explicitly mentions OCR or the ability to search the archive. Missing for 10: explicit OCR of scans, full-text search of mail content, search/filter by sender and date, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
